import numpy as np

class CommEfficientFL:
    def __init__(self, compression_ratio=0.1, num_bits=8):
        self.compression_ratio = compression_ratio
        self.num_bits = num_bits
    def topk_sparse(self, update):
        flat = update.flatten()
        k = max(1, int(len(flat) * self.compression_ratio))
        top_k_idx = np.argpartition(np.abs(flat), -k)[-k:]
        sparse_flat = np.zeros_like(flat)
        sparse_flat[top_k_idx] = flat[top_k_idx]
        return sparse_flat.reshape(update.shape), top_k_idx
    def quantize(self, update):
        min_val, max_val = np.min(update), np.max(update)
        if max_val == min_val:
            return update
        levels = 2 ** self.num_bits - 1
        normalized = (update - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        quantized = np.round(normalized * levels) / levels
        return quantized * (max_val - min_val) + min_val
    def compress_update(self, update):
        sparse, indices = self.topk_sparse(update)
        quantized = self.quantize(sparse)
        return quantized, indices
    def decompress_update(self, quantized, indices, shape):
        full_update = np.zeros(shape)
        flat_q = quantized.flatten()
        flat_full = full_update.flatten()
        flat_full[indices] = flat_q[indices]
        return flat_full.reshape(shape)
